shots.line: Under the northern lights, Helsinki is quiet.
At Vuorikatu 20 stands Varjo, founded in 2016 by Niko Eiden, Urho Konttori, Klaus Melakari, and Roope Rainisto.
Here, between 201 and 500 employees design and manufacture mixed-reality headsets and training solutions.
Varjo builds the XR-4 series for air, land, and sea simulation, alongside its Varjo Base software.
Backed by investors like EQT Ventures and Atomico, the company raised a 40 million dollar Series D in September 2022.
